title: pvCalculator
body:
## pvCalculator

Full native Calculator: evaluates an expression over point, cell, row or other attribute arrays and stores the result as a new array of a chosen numeric type, or, with CoordinateResults, as new point coordinates (moving the mesh), or as normals or texture coordinates. Output has the input's data type. Use calculator for the common point/cell array case.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- AttributeType is the ParaView entry text ("Point Data", "Cell Data", "Row Data" for tables, …), the same texts the calculator operation uses; the expression may only use arrays of that association.
- CoordinateResults needs a 3-component result; a scalar expression cannot move points.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Calculator`. Identity: `filters/Calculator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset (vtkDataSet, vtkTable or vtkGraph) to the Calculator filter. The scalar and vector variables may be chosen from this dataset's arrays. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); graphs (vertices and edges) (vtkGraph); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkGraph","vtkTable","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AttributeType` | Data association the expression is evaluated on and the result is stored in; the same "Point Data" and "Cell Data" texts select the association in the calculator operation. Chosen by the ParaView entry text: "Point Data", "Cell Data", "Vertex Data", "Edge Data" or "Row Data". ParaView offers only the associations the connected input has (for example "Row Data" for a table), so a text it does not offer fails with NATIVE_DOMAIN_MISMATCH when the node is configured. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Point Data","Cell Data","Vertex Data","Edge Data","Row Data"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Point Data"` |
| `CoordinateResults` | The value of this property determines whether the results of this computation should be used as point coordinates or as a new array. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Function` | This property contains the equation for computing the new array. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `FunctionParserType` | Hidden ParaView switch selecting the expression parser: 1 uses the ExprTk-based parser introduced in ParaView 5.10 (vtkExprTkFunctionParser), 0 the older vtkFunctionParser of ParaView 5.9 and earlier, kept for old state files. Leave it unset unless an old expression only parses with the legacy parser. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ReplaceInvalidResults` | This property determines whether invalid values in the computation will be replaced with a specific value. (See the ReplacementValue property.) | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReplacementValue` | If invalid values in the computation are to be replaced with another value, this property contains that value. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ResultArrayName` | This property contains the name for the output array containing the result of this computation. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ResultArrayType` | This property determines what array type to output. The default is a vtkDoubleArray. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Char","Signed Char","Unsigned Char","Short","Unsigned Short","Int","Unsigned Int","Long","Unsigned Long","Float","Double","Id Type"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Char"` |
| `ResultNormals` | Set whether to output results as point/cell normals. Outputting as normals is only valid with vector results. Point or cell normals are selected using AttributeMode. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ResultTCoords` | Set whether to output results as point/cell texture coordinates. Point or cell texture coordinates are selected using AttributeMode. 2-component texture coordinates cannot be generated at this time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCalculator",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
